# skopec.dev

> Personal portfolio of Josef — graphic design, web development, and home lab.

## Pages
- [Home](https://skopec.dev/): Intro, self-hosted services, friends, FAQ, contact
- [Projects](https://skopec.dev/projects.html): Selected work and lab experiments
- [Hardware](https://skopec.dev/hardware.html): Desktop, laptop, server, and phone specs
- [Privacy](https://skopec.dev/privacy.html): Short privacy note for this personal site

## Services
Local 10.0.0.x addresses work only on the home network or with Josef’s Tailscale.
- Proxmox VE: 10.0.0.200:8006 (13 LXCs + 1 VM)
- Pi-hole & DNSCrypt (CT 100): 10.0.0.100/admin
- Jellyfin (CT 101): https://jelly.skopec.dev · 10.0.0.101:8096
- Seerr (CT 101): 10.0.0.101:5055 (media requests & discovery)
- *Arr Automation Stack (CT 101): Sonarr (10.0.0.101:8989), Radarr (:7878), Bazarr (:6767), Prowlarr (:9696), qBittorrent (:8080)
- OpenMediaVault NAS (VM 102): 10.0.0.102 (SMB storage server)
- Navidrome (CT 103): 10.0.0.103:4533
- SearXNG (CT 104): 10.0.0.104:8080
- Cloudflare Tunnels (CT 105): 10.0.0.105 (exposes services outside the LAN)
- Open WebUI & Ollama (CT 106): 10.0.0.106:3000 (Open WebUI) · 10.0.0.106:11434 (Ollama API)
- ConvertX (CT 107): 10.0.0.107:3000
- Nginx Web Server (CT 108): 10.0.0.108 (serves skopec.dev)
- Immich (CT 109): 10.0.0.109:2283
- Tailscale (CT 110): 10.0.0.110 (Mesh VPN Gateway for remote access to local-only services)
- Joplin Server (CT 111): 10.0.0.111:22300
- Homepage (CT 112): 10.0.0.112 (Homelab Command Center unified dashboard)
- Nextcloud (CT 113): 10.0.0.113 (self-hosted cloud storage & files)
